title: fix(metadata-protocol): a sealed-item refusal of a create names a free name, not the edit remedy (#22591)
body:
Fixes #22591
Clause-②: yes

The sealed-item refusal (`403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`) now names the remedy that fits what the caller did. This closes out the family that #20819 (flow) and #20910 (action, permission) worked through one type at a time.

- **An edit** of the item under a held name keeps its sentence, byte for byte. That is the row's sanctioned path, or "Edit the source artifact and redeploy" for a type without a row.
- **A create** under a name that a managed package or a built-in holds, or **a rename into** such a name, is now told: the name is taken; to author your own item, choose a name no package or built-in holds, and `GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE` lists the names in use.

Which writes are refused does not change, and neither do the code or the status.

## Measured at the real doors (showcase, `single`)

The probe was a local file, never committed and deleted after the run. It booted the real showcase composition through `bootShowcase`, signed in as the seeded admin, and used the HTTP doors. **Before** was `origin/main` `d748ae80af`, with the dogfood dependency closure built from it. **After** was this branch at `6499e49c0f`, with `metadata-protocol` and `plugin-security` rebuilt from that head.

| Door and request | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Setup `POST /data/sys_position` with `manager` (package `com.example.showcase`) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, "… Edit the source artifact and redeploy." | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, "… so its name is taken. To author your own position, choose a name no package or built-in holds (GET /api/v1/meta/position lists the names in use)." |
| Setup create of `guest` (built-in, `com.objectstack.plugin-security`) | 403, edit remedy | 403, create remedy |
| Setup `PATCH` renaming an admin position into `exec` | 403, edit remedy | 403, create remedy |
| `PUT /meta/position/manager` with `If-None-Match: *` (the first-write precondition) | 403, edit remedy | 403, create remedy |
| `PUT /meta/flow/showcase_task_completed` with `If-None-Match: *` | 403, clone and switch | 403, create remedy, citing ADR-0126 |
| `PUT /meta/position/manager` with no precondition, and with `?mode=draft` | 403, edit remedy | 403, edit remedy (unchanged) |
| `PUT /meta/flow/showcase_task_completed` with no precondition | 403, clone and switch | unchanged |
| `POST /automation` onto `showcase_task_completed` | 403, clone and switch | unchanged (see the Acceptance notes) |
| Setup create of `p22591_lead` (control) | 201 | 201 |

`GET /api/v1/meta/position` listed `manager`, `exec`, `everyone`, `guest` and the other held names, so the remedy's pointer answers.

## One create-aware sentence, not a `position` row

This was the claimant's choice to make by measurement. The create remedy does not depend on the type: on every type, a create under a held name has one remedy, which is another name. So `heldNameSentence` in `packaged-base-regime.ts` is one sentence for every type. Only its opener and its citation come from the type's row, as in the edit sentences. An origin-gated `datasource` is "code-defined", not shipped by a managed package. A Regime C type cites ADR-0126, whose §2 makes a new machine name mandatory for an item authored beside a packaged one. A per-type `position` row would have fixed one of the 24 reachable types and left the rest for a fourth card. A type added to the registry later gets the create remedy without a row.

## Where the act comes from

The act is the caller's fact and is never inferred. A door that cannot tell keeps the edit remedy.

- `managedItemSealedSentence(type, name, operation)` takes `'save' | 'create' | 'delete'`. A `'create'` reads `heldNameSentence`.
- `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.packagedBaseRefusal` takes `operation: 'create'`, with the same predicate, code and status as `'save'`. `refusePackagedBaseOverride` passes the act through to the sentence and to nothing else.
- **Setup** (`plugin-security`, `position-write-through.ts`): the S10 verdict is asked only for a create or a rename into a name, so it now asks with `operation: 'create'`. This is the producer of the card's measured symptom, in another package. The dispatch allowed fixing it at the producer.
- **The `/meta` save door** (`saveMetaItem`): its one fact about the name is the first-write pin. A present `null` `parentVersion` (`If-None-Match: *`) asserts that the caller holds no row there, which the spec calls the first-write pin, so it is read as a create. It reaches both locked-base doors: `tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal` (flows, which gains an optional `operation`) and the package door. Any other save is an edit.
- **`SysMetadataRepository.assertAllowed`** (the third caller the dispatch named) is unchanged. Its saves are server replays of the item's own stored history (draft promotion, restore, revert), which are edits, and it has no create fact to pass.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.sealed-remedy-kind.test.ts` (new):
  - **Enumeration pin.** Every type the refusal reaches is measured by asking the verdict, never from a transcribed list. That is the 23 registry types with no overlay channel plus a plugin-registered type, on both kernel shapes. Asserted equal to the registry's own flag, with a floor. For each type, an edit names the edit remedy and a create names the create remedy. The kind is read off what the sentence points at: the row's own routes or source (read from `PACKAGED_BASE_REGIME`), the source/redeploy remedy, or the type's listing route. The wording is not asserted.
  - **Controls.** A create is refused exactly where a save is, with `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / 403 on every row. A free name is `null` for both acts. A removal names no new name. Every create sentence for an 88-character name arrives whole under the REST door's 500-character bound, with no hatch, clone or switch.
  - **The `/meta` door.** For `position` and `flow`: a first-write save names the create remedy, and an unpinned or `If-Match` save keeps the edit remedy, with the same code and status. The door's message equals the verdict's (one emitter).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-write-through.test.ts`:
  - S10's "the door's own refusal" pin now compares the Setup create with the door's first-write save, because a create relays the door's answer to a create.
  - New: a create under a package-held name and under a built-in (`everyone`) names the create remedy, while the door's edit refusal of the same name keeps the edit remedy. A rename into `guest` names the create remedy.

**Ablation, run at `6499e49c0f` with the fix committed first.** Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the line `if (operation === 'create') return heldNameSentence(singular, name);` was replaced with a comment, which collapses a create back to the edit remedy. On disk the anchor count went 1 → 0 and the marker count 0 → 1. Both suites then ran. `metadata-protocol` had 5 failed and 5 passed: every create row flipped to `"create": "edit"`, while the reachability, verdict and removal controls stayed green. `plugin-security` had 3 failed and 41 passed. The restore put the blob back equal to `HEAD` (`a0fda00025d8`) with `git diff HEAD` empty. Neither suite reads `dist/`: the test imports `./protocol.js`, and plugin-security's vitest config aliases `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` to its `src`. So the ablation needed no rebuild.

**Runs at `3c3e4ef362`** (this branch after merging `origin/main` `18d999031b`; the merge brought no change to either touched file):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: `Test Files 224 passed | 3 skipped (227)`, `Tests 28314 passed | 19 skipped (28333)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run`: `Test Files 194 passed (194)`, `Tests 4096 passed | 45 skipped (4141)`.
- `typecheck` passes for both packages, plugin-security's `check:test-typecheck` included. `tsc --listFiles` counts each touched test file once in its package's program.
- The 69 gate commands `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for this diff all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`: 69 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. One note: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3) because 8 unrelated packages had no `dist/`. After building them it exited 0.
- eslint, narrowed to the 5 touched TypeScript files, with `--no-inline-config` and `--format json`: 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Each file is inside the config (`--print-config` resolves). The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. The repository-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Studio's create form still gets the edit remedy until objectui declares its create.** The `/meta` PUT is an upsert, so an unpinned save onto a held name is an edit by the door's contract. Studio's create mode sends no precondition (objectui `ResourceEditPage` create path). Its comment says the door cannot express "expect no row", which has not been true since the door took `If-None-Match: *`. The server half is here. The client half is to send `If-None-Match: *` on create. It is reported for the seat to file in objectui, with this PR as its blocker.
- **`POST /automation` onto a packaged flow's name is unchanged.** That door's own contract makes a create onto an existing name an overwrite, which is an edit, so its clone-and-switch remedy matches what it does. `POST /automation/:name/clone` refuses any target name the engine already holds with its own name-taken refusal first (read in `automation.ts`, not probed).
- **Code-only types** (`allowRuntimeCreate: false`) are refused at `/meta` by their own emitter (`codeOnlyOverrideError`) before the package door. It says "declare it in source". That is right for a create too, because such a type has no runtime create.
- **Clause-② reads `yes`.** `packagedBaseRefusal` accepts `operation: 'create'`, and `tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal` takes an optional operation. That widens a public input surface, so both packages take `minor`. No verdict, code or status moves. The seat answered the question A and amended its claim (6093560675). Patch round 1 (6094616222, head `caeb7b58f1`) changed the changeset only.
- No other region of `protocol.ts` or `sys-metadata-repository.ts` is touched. The seat's #15206 S5 read-path work does not overlap.
